exposure: PH group (Group 1 PH vs other PH groups)
outcome: Maternal death within 10 days after delivery
cohort: This study included 299 pregnant women with PH admitted for delivery between 2012 and 2020.
finding: NT-proBNP, pulmonary artery systolic pressure (PASP), and albumin were identified as the most important predictors of maternal death in women with PH.
